output_list.criticism: The 'transferFrom' function and the 'approve' function have integer overflow vulnerabilities. The condition '_amount > 0 && balances[_to] + _amount > balances[_to]' can be exploited to overflow the balance of the target user, allowing attackers to steal funds. The condition 'allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _amount' can be exploited to overflow the allowance, allowing attackers to steal funds.
